resources.name: EON software for atomic scale simulations

access.notes: Open-source software for long-time scale atomistic simulations, including saddle-point search and global optimization methods (EON distribution).

resources.name: SMTBQ potential parameters for rutile TiO2

access.notes: Parameters for the second-moment tight-binding charge-transfer model; obtainable from the literature or as part of the EON distribution.

resources.name: Open-source DFT code with PBE+U (e.g., Quantum ESPRESSO)

access.notes: Plane-wave/pseudopotential DFT code capable of spin-polarized calculations with PBE and DFT+U; an open-source equivalent to VASP.
